newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks ended slightly down on Tuesday as speculators squared positions on settlement day, but short-covering in selected blue chips curbed losses, dealers said.

"Investors continue to remain on the sidelines bacause of the country's grim economic outlook," dealer Hina Akhlaq said. "The weakness in neighbouring India is another factor that has further weakenedd the sentiment."
The Karachi index fell 3.57 points, or 0.23 percent, to end at 1,565.26. Losers beat gainers 221 to 58. Bank of Punjab fell 2.70 rupees to 25.35. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
